what: Hover over the full-width pixel wordmark and a color-inverted circle (diameter 4% of width) follows the cursor, and the letter cells split to both sides around its horizontal position. Left cells go left, right cells go right, shrinking in a bell shape the farther they are from the center (max 3.3% of width · spread σ 5.1% of width) and the letters distort. The center of the split chases the cursor by .2 each frame, and when the hand is released it sweeps out past the left edge in .33s (power2.in) and the letters return to place

options.[data-fx-part=word]: Wordmark svg — each direct child shape (rect · path) is a slot that moves on its own. A viewBox is required
options.strength: Maximum split distance (share of wordmark width), default .033
options.spread: Spread width σ of the cracking (fraction of wordmark width), default .051
options.radius: Radius of the inverted circle (share of wordmark width), default .02
options.follow: Per-frame share by which the crack center chases the cursor, default .2
options.out: Duration (s) of sweeping out past the left edge after release, default .33
options.--fx-lens-ink: Text color inside the circle (via style), default var(--kf-bg) — on a dark panel, use that panel’s background color

note: The original plays a Rive file (word_brand.riv · State Machine 1 · hover in/out triggers) — the .riv is an original asset so it is not used. Instead the archived copy was replayed, the canvas read every frame to measure crack size, spread, chase lag and the sweep-away length on leave, and it was rebuilt as SVG cell shifts. Static image on touch screens and with reduced motion.

from.where: shared.js footer .h-foot__mark screen-width pixel wordmark — original Rive word_brand.riv (fit cover · canvas 113% of footer width · cursor circle diameter about 60px · split max about 48px · σ about 80px · chase lag about 40px · leave 330ms to the left)
